name: Sleepy Ridge Weddings
description: A country-club-style reception venue on a golf course near Utah Lake, with indoor and outdoor spaces, mountain and lake views, gardens, a gazebo, and separate areas for ceremonies and receptions.
priceText: Wedding rental by date and season, $4,200–$7,000

Features > Linens included.wording: Floor Length Linens of any Color

Features > Outside catering allowed.wording: No in-house catering or required vendor list

items.label: Description
items.value: A country-club-style reception venue on a golf course near Utah Lake, with indoor and outdoor spaces, mountain and lake views, gardens, a gazebo, and separate areas for ceremonies and receptions.

items.label: Address
items.value: 730 S Sleepy Ridge Dr, Orem, UT 84059

items.label: Price
items.value: Wedding rental by date and season, $4,200–$7,000

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
Sunset Room rental with 60-inch round tables, 8-foot and 6-foot banquet tables, 36-inch bistro tables, in-house chairs, floor-length linens in any color, centerpieces, setup and take-down, onsite venue attendant, floor and table easels, Wi-Fi, ice machine, Bluetooth sound system, wireless microphone, 95-inch HD TVs, warming/prep kitchen, wedding suite, sunset balcony bistro lighting, large fireplace and mantle, large parking area, building/grounds/golf course access for photography — Mon-Wed 4pm-11pm $4,200
Same inclusions — Thu 4pm-11pm $4,700
Same inclusions — Fri 11am-11pm $6,500
Same inclusions — Sat-Sun 11am-11pm $7,000
Luncheon rental (all room-rental items) — Mon-Thu 9am-2pm $3,000
Garden Patio ceremony and Front Garden cocktail-hour add-on — $1,000
Additional setup fee — $250
Alcohol venue fee — $750
Holiday pricing: inquire

items.label: Deposit
items.value:
50% of room rental
Non-refundable and non-transferable
Final payment due two weeks before the event

items.label: Sunset Room
items.value: Seated: 250 · Standing: 700 · Sq ft: 4160 · Setting: indoor (third floor, balcony)

items.label: Garden Patio
items.value: Ceremony seated: 150 · Sq ft: 2160 · Setting: outdoor · Note: $1,000 add-on with Front Garden cocktail hour

items.label: Rain plan
items.value: If the weather turns, the indoor reception space is already set (Rooms page).

items.label: Linens included
items.value: Floor Length Linens of any Color

Ample parking for guests
